subject: Need clarification for the key val pairs in reducer

messages.author: 580bb38be8331ff1
messages.subject: Need clarification for the key val pairs in reducer
parts:
Hi all, I am new to rmr2 and mapreduce. I have a question about the key val pairs in the reducer.

In a mapreduce process, two mappers return key val pairs as below,
mapper 1 
k is c("apple", "orange")
v is c(3, 7)

mapper 2
k is c("apple", "banana")
v is c(1, 10)

As part of the reduce process, which key val pairs do the reducer get?

Case 1
k is c("apple", "apple")
v is c(3 , 1)

OR

Case 2
k is "apple"
v is c(3, 1)

Thanks

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#854] Need clarification for the key val pairs in reducer
parts:
Hi,
I was not aware of the possibility of a single mapreduce process with two mappers. In the case of the single mapper,  the following program will answer your question

from.dfs(mapreduce(to.dfs(keyval(rep(1, 10), 1:10)), reduce = function(k,vv) length(k)))


Antonio
